arcs.name: Bull Market
arcs.description: Markets are soaring and everyone's a genius. The Dow just hit a record high, housing prices keep climbing, and money flows freely. A perfect time to learn the basics — just don't get too comfortable.

arcs.name: The Unraveling
arcs.description: Something is wrong. Banks are reporting massive losses, Bear Stearns just collapsed, and the word 'subprime' is on everyone's lips. The easy money is over. Now it's about reading the signs and managing your risk.

arcs.name: Meltdown
arcs.description: Lehman Brothers is gone. The government is bailing out banks. The market is in freefall. This is the crisis they'll write about for decades. Survival is the only goal — if you can break even, you're a legend.
